Binta Traore is a Staff Security Engineer at MedTech Solutions, where she balances technical rigor with a pragmatic approach to solving complex healthtech challenges.  

Her application security work at MedTech has directly shaped patient data protections. She led an initiative to align internal tools with OWASP guidelines, reducing critical vulnerabilities in a flagship EHR platform by 40% over 18 months. Her ownership of this project included designing automated checks and training cross-functional teams on secure coding practices.  

Binta’s IAM architecture at MedTech is both innovative and scalable. She designed a role-based access system that streamlined compliance while cutting administrative overhead by 30%. Her mentorship in this area has influenced how new engineers approach identity management across the organization.  

She approaches security as a proactive discipline, not just a compliance checkbox. During a recent ransomware incident, her rapid response and coordination with IT minimized downtime. She also integrates penetration testing into routine workflows, ensuring defenses evolve with emerging threats.  

Binta’s curiosity and attention to detail make her a reliable collaborator. She consistently prioritizes clarity and long-term stability, whether refining access controls or debugging security protocols. Her work at MedTech reflects a rare ability to merge technical precision with real-world impact.
